COLUMN.name: Assets Pending Approval
COLUMN.descr: Count of FAM_ASSET_TRANSFER + FAM_ASSET_DISPOSAL records currently in PENDING_APPROVAL status, scoped by branch. Asset Register cannot be included: the deployed FAM_ASSET_REGISTER table carries only ASSET_CODE/ASSET_NAME/CAPITALIZATION_DATE with no STATUS column. Depreciation cannot be included: no Depreciation generation/posting/register table is deployed (only the rate masters FAM_DEP_RATE_CA_MASTER/FAM_DEP_RATE_IT_MASTER exist, which carry no transactional PENDING_APPROVAL records). Swap in Asset Register and Depreciation counts once those tables are deployed with a matching STATUS column.

SQLMODEL.SCHEMA_DESCR: VIS_003 — Assets Pending Approval KPI card for the Asset/Finance Manager Management Dashboard. Assumption (data availability): the FRS describes this as a count across Asset Register/Transfer/Disposal/Depreciation records in Pending Approval status, but only two of those four record types have a deployed table with a matching STATUS: FAM_ASSET_TRANSFER (allowed value PENDING_APPROVAL) and FAM_ASSET_DISPOSAL (allowed value PENDING_APPROVAL). FAM_ASSET_REGISTER is deployed with only ASSET_CODE/ASSET_NAME/CAPITALIZATION_DATE (no STATUS column), and no Depreciation generation/posting/register table is deployed at all (only the rate masters FAM_DEP_RATE_CA_MASTER/FAM_DEP_RATE_IT_MASTER exist). So this card sums PENDING_APPROVAL counts from FAM_ASSET_TRANSFER + FAM_ASSET_DISPOSAL only; extend the SUM with Asset Register and Depreciation once those tables/columns are deployed. Assumption (FY criterion): unlike the sibling Gross/Net value cards, this backlog-style count is NOT scoped by FINANCIAL_YEAR — a pending-approval queue should surface every outstanding record regardless of when it was raised, so filtering it to the current FY would hide older still-unapproved items, which is the opposite of what an approvals backlog KPI is for. Assumption (branch default): 'logged-in user's branch, selectable All' is implemented as an optional 'like' filter defaulting to '%' (All) with an F2 lookup to FAM_BRANCH_MASTER, applied against FAM_ASSET_TRANSFER.TO_BRANCH_CODE directly and against FAM_ASSET_DISPOSAL's asset resolved to its latest APPROVED FAM_ASSET_TRANSFER branch (disposal itself carries no branch column); wiring the true logged-in-user's-branch default requires a project variable (:user_site or similar) that was not confirmed to exist in this project. No sparkline — the FRS specifies a plain Card. Drill-through: none specified in the FRS for this tile.

COLUMNS.NAME: LBL_HEADLINE
COLUMNS.name: Caption
COLUMNS.descr: Fixed caption under the headline number

SOURCE_SQL:
SELECT
  (
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fam_asset_transfer t
     WHERE t.status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'
       AND COALESCE(t.to_branch_code, '') LIKE ?.branch_code)
    +
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fam_asset_disposal d
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT tr.to_branch_code
       FROM fam_asset_transfer tr
       WHERE tr.asset_code = d.asset_code AND tr.status = 'APPROVED'
       ORDER BY tr.transfer_date DESC
       LIMIT 1
     ) cur ON TRUE
     WHERE d.status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'
       AND COALESCE(cur.to_branch_code, '') LIKE ?.branch_code)
  ) AS PENDING_APPROVAL_COUNT,
  'Assets Pending Approval (Transfer + Disposal)' AS LBL_HEADLINE
